bots.title: Bot players
bots.hint: A player or two short? Fill empty seats with bots. They sit down ready and the server plays their moves. A game with bots pays a quarter of the coins and earns no badges; it still counts on your card.

tictactoe.intro: The classic: two players take turns on a 3 × 3 board.

overview.win: Get three of your marks in a row to win. A full board with no line is a draw.

play.lead: Taking turns, one mark at a time.

first.title: Crosses go first
first.detail: The first player places crosses, the second noughts.

turn.title: Take turns
turn.detail: Tap an empty square to place your mark. Marks never move.

line.title: Three in a row wins
line.detail: Across, down or corner to corner.

draw.title: Full board, no line
draw.detail: All nine squares filled and no line: a draw.

play.note: Take the centre or a corner, and always block two in a row. Best of all: make two threats at once — a fork — so only one can be blocked.

avalon.intro: The agents try to complete three operations. Moles hide among them and try to make three operations fail.

overview.lead: A team game of hidden roles: agents against the moles hiding among them.
overview.win: Agents win by completing three operations. Moles win by making three fail.
overview.shot: Even if the agents succeed, the Hitman gets one shot at the Handler, and a hit steals the win.

teams.lead: Every player is secretly on one of two sides.

good.name: Agents
good.text: Most of the table, and nearly all of them know nothing. They win when three operations succeed and the Hitman then misses the Handler.

evil.name: Moles
evil.text: They know each other (except the Wildcard). They win with three failed operations, {{rejections}} rejected teams in a row, or the Hitman finding the Handler.

roles.lead: Who you might be. Only you see your card; some roles also see others.
roles.merlin: Sees every mole except the Sleeper. Guide the agents with hints: if the Hitman names you at the end, the moles win.
roles.percival: Sees the Handler and the Decoy, but can't tell which is which. Find the real Handler and protect them.
roles.servant: Knows nothing. Watch the votes and the results to find the moles.
roles.assassin: Knows the other moles (not the Wildcard). If the agents win three operations, takes one shot at the Handler.
roles.morgana: Knows the other moles (not the Wildcard). Looks like the Handler to the Bodyguard.
roles.mordred: Knows the other moles (not the Wildcard), and the Handler can't see the Sleeper.
roles.oberon: A mole alone: doesn't know the other moles, and they don't know the Wildcard. The Handler does see the Wildcard.
roles.minion: Knows the other moles (not the Wildcard). Sabotage without getting caught.

play.lead: Up to five operations. Each one goes like this:

role.title: Look at your role
role.detail: At the start, tap your card to see who you are and whom you know. Keep it secret.

team.title: The leader picks a team
team.detail: The leader picks as many players as the operation needs. Everyone sees the picks. Talk it over.

vote.title: Everyone votes
vote.detail: Approve or reject, all at once. More than half must approve; a tie rejects.

rejected.title: Rejected? Next leader
rejected.detail: The leader's crown moves one seat and a new team is picked. {{rejections}} rejected teams in a row and the moles win.

operation.title: The team plays its cards
operation.detail: Each member secretly holds Success or Fail for 2 seconds. Agents can only play Success; moles may play either.

verdict.title: The verdict
verdict.detail: The cards are shown with no names. One Fail sinks the operation (Operation 4 needs two with 7 or more players). Then the next leader picks.

end.title: Three of a kind ends it
end.detail: Three failed operations: the moles win. Three successes: on to the Hitman's shot.

shot.title: The Hitman's shot
shot.detail: The moles are revealed and talk it over. The Hitman holds to name one agent: the Handler means the moles win; anyone else, the agents win.

play.talk: Talk out loud; anyone may lie. Votes are public, but nobody ever learns who played a Fail.
play.tip: Handler: hint, don't announce. Moles: playing Success can earn trust.

counts.lead: Who is in the game and how big each operation's team is, by number of players.
counts.twoFails: * This operation needs two Fail cards to fail.

coup.intro: A bluffing card game: claim any role, call out lies, and be the last player with a card left.

overview.lead: A bluffing card game: be the last player with a card left.
overview.cards: Everyone gets two secret cards and {{cash}}. Each card is a role, and each role has a power.
overview.win: Claim any role, even one you don't hold. If someone calls your bluff and you're caught, you lose a card. Lose both and you're out.

roles.lead: Five roles, three cards of each. You may claim any of them, whether you hold it or not.
roles.duke: The money maker. Collects rent and stops anyone borrowing.
roles.assassin: Pays to rough up a player, who loses a card.
roles.captain: Takes $2 from another player, and stops others pickpocketing you.
roles.ambassador: Swaps cards with the deck to change roles in secret, and stops pickpocketing.
roles.contessa: Has no action of her own, but saves you from being roughed up.

play.lead: Players take turns in order. Each turn goes like this:

act.title: Choose one action
act.detail: Lay your chip on an action on the felt. With {{forced}} or more you must Shut Down.

claim.title: Claim its role, if it has one
claim.detail: An action with a role says you hold that card. You may be bluffing.

challenge.title: Anyone may challenge
challenge.detail: Everyone else lets it go or challenges. Caught bluffing: you lose a card and the action is off. Telling the truth: the challenger loses a card, and your shown card is swapped for a new one.

block.title: Some actions can be blocked
block.detail: A block claims a role too, so it can be challenged the same way. Actions shows who blocks what.

resolve.title: Nobody stopped it? It happens
resolve.detail: Take the money, swap the cards, or make your target lose a card. Then it's the next player's turn.

lose.title: Losing a card
lose.detail: You pick which of your cards to turn face up. It stays out for good.

win.title: Last one standing wins
win.detail: Lose both cards and you're out. The last player with a face-down card wins.

play.doubleLoss: Rough Up's {{cost}} is spent even if it's blocked. Bluff Auntie against it and get caught, and you lose both cards at once.
play.secret: Only you can see your cards. Tap them to hide them when someone might peek.

actions.lead: One action per turn. An action that claims a role can be challenged.
actions.forced: With {{forced}} or more at the start of your turn, you must Shut Down someone.

counts.lead: Every game uses the same {{cards}} cards: three of each role.
counts.two: With 2 players, whoever goes first starts with {{first}} instead of {{cash}}.
counts.leave: If a player leaves mid-game, the game ends with no winner.

effects.steal: Take $2 from another player (or whatever they have, if less).
effects.exchange: Draw 2 cards from the deck, then return any 2. Changes your roles in secret.
effects.assassinate: Choose a player; they lose a card.
effects.coup: Choose a player; they lose a card. Nothing can stop it.

manor.intro: A rich old man has his relatives over for the night. Some of them are intruders in disguise.

overview.win: The intruders win if they hit him twice before dawn. The household wins if he is alive at 6 AM, or every intruder is locked up.
overview.length: {{min}}–{{max}} players · {{hours}} hours of night · about 30 minutes.

teams.lead: Two sides. Nobody knows who is who — except the intruders, who know each other.

household.name: Household
household.text: The Butler, the Guard and the Guests. Keep the old man alive until 6 AM, or lock up every intruder.

intruders.name: Intruders
intruders.text: Hit the old man twice before dawn. If he survives, name the Butler at dawn and you still win.

roles.lead: Your role is secret. You see it when the night begins.
roles.butler: Always knows which room the old man was in when the hour began. Guide the household, quietly: if the intruders name you at dawn, they win.
roles.guard: Carries the flashlight: see who is in your room and what each of them does. Your searches show who you patted down and what they carry.
roles.guest: No special power. Guard the old man, fix cameras, search, and work out who the intruders are.
roles.intruder: Knows the other intruders. Slips into any room each hour, attacks with a weapon, breaks cameras. Once a game, can hide a weapon from searches.

play.lead: The night runs from 10 PM to 6 AM. Every hour has two secret steps.

start.title: Night falls
start.detail: Everyone starts in the Grand Hall, the old man in the Bedroom. Look at your role.

move.title: Move
move.detail: Secretly stay, or go one room up, down, left or right. Intruders may go to any room.

act.title: Act
act.detail: Secretly pick one action for your room (see Actions). Everything happens at once.

dark.title: It's dark
dark.detail: You only learn whether someone else is in your room and whether the old man is — not who, or what they did. Your notebook keeps what you learned.

owner.title: The old man wanders
owner.detail: Each hour he steps to a room next door, or stays — unless someone escorted him.

meet.title: Talk and vote
meet.detail: At the meetings (see Special events), share what you saw — or lie — and vote someone locked up.

dawn.title: Dawn
dawn.detail: If he is still alive at 6 AM, the intruders get one last guess at the Butler.

play.note: Nobody may stay in the Security Room two hours in a row.

actions.lead: Pick one each hour. What you can do depends on your room and your role.
actions.attack: Hurts him if attackers outnumber guards. Every hit makes him scream.
actions.escort: He follows you next hour instead of wandering.
actions.take: Pick up the weapon lying in your room. You carry one thing; taking another leaves yours behind.
actions.fix: Turn a broken camera on. It records who comes and goes.
actions.break: Turn a working camera off. Nobody is told.
actions.watch: See who each working camera saw this hour, and whether the old man came or went — not what anyone did.
actions.search: Pat down someone at random in your room: you only feel whether they carry something. The Guard sees who it was and what.
actions.flashlight: See who is in your room and what each of them does this hour.
actions.hide: Along with your action: searches find nothing on you this hour.

rooms.lead: Nine rooms on a 3 × 3 floor plan. You step to the room next door, never diagonally.
rooms.security: Watch the monitors here and see every camera. No staying two hours in a row.
rooms.note: Every camera starts the night broken. You only see a camera's state from its own room or from the Security Room.

scream.name: A scream
scream.text: When the old man is hit, everyone hears which room — not who did it. A meeting follows. A second hit kills him.

meeting.name: Household meeting
meeting.text: After midnight, after 3 AM and after every scream. Everyone still free votes; a majority locks a player up for the rest of the night, their role kept secret. Lock up every intruder and the household wins.

dawn.name: Dawn
dawn.text: At 6 AM the intruders are revealed. Their ringleader names one player as the Butler: right, and the intruders win; wrong, and the household wins.

counts.note: With {{min}} players the lone intruder starts the night holding the knife.

liarsdice.intro: The bar classic: everyone shakes five dice under a cup and looks only at their own.

overview.calls: Take turns calling how many dice of one face are on the whole table, each call higher than the last — until someone calls it a lie.
overview.win: Lose a call and you drink. Knockout: {{cups}} cups and you're out, and the last one standing wins. Endless: the fewest cups win when the table stops.

play.lead: A round, from the shake to the drink.

shake.title: Everyone shakes
shake.detail: Five dice each, under your cup. Look only at your own.

call.title: The first call
call.detail: "4 × fives" means at least four 5s on the whole table, counting everyone's dice. How low the first call may go depends on the way of calling (below).

raise.title: Raise, or call a lie
raise.detail: Next player: call higher — more dice, or as many of a higher face — or open the last call. Faces rank 2 < 3 < 4 < 5 < 6 < 1.

reveal.title: Lift the cups and count
reveal.detail: Enough dice: whoever called the lie drinks. Too few: the bidder drinks.

again.title: Shake again
again.detail: The loser starts the next round.

kaizhai.name: Kaizhai (开斋): 1s are wild
kaizhai.text: 1s count as any face. Once a call goes kaizhai the round stays kaizhai: no more zhai, and no more 1s.

zhai.name: Zhai (斋): 1s are just 1s
zhai.text: A zhai call (斋) makes 1s count only as 1s. Calling 1s is always zhai.

leopard.name: Five that count (豹子)
leopard.text: A cup whose five dice all count for the call counts as six — with wild 1s, two 1s and three 3s are six 3s.

bigLeopard.name: Five the same (大豹子)
bigLeopard.text: Five of the very same number counts as seven: five 3s are seven 3s, and when 1s are wild five 1s are seven of whatever was called.

knockout.name: Knockout
knockout.text: {{cups}} cups and you're drunk — out. The last one standing wins.

endless.name: Endless
endless.text: Nobody is ever out; cups add up. When more than half the table votes to stop, the fewest cups win.

play.note: The host picks the mode and the way of calling in the lobby.

jijiji.name: Ji Ji Ji (几几几)
jijiji.text: The Hong Kong and Macau bar rule, by the players still in. With {{n}} players: {{one}} dice may only be 1s, from {{zhai}} any face zhai, from {{fei}} kaizhai too — no doubling. Player counts has every table size.

classic.name: Classic (经典)
classic.text: Open with more dice than players, or as many zhai. Going kaizhai after a zhai call needs double the dice (after 3 × fours zhai, at least 6).

nozhai.name: No zhai (不玩斋)
nozhai.text: 1s are always wild and can't be called; every call is kaizhai. Open with more dice than players.

actions.lead: On your turn you call or open. Anyone may split, any time.

call.name: Call
call.text: Name a count and a face, higher than the last call — zhai or kaizhai, as the way of calling allows. Each button shows exactly the call it makes.

open.name: Open (开)
open.text: Call the last call a lie. Everyone lifts their cup. Enough dice: you drink. Too few: the bidder drinks.

split.name: Split (劈)
split.text: No need to wait for your turn: call the last call a lie at any moment (just not your own). The bidder then accepts or counters.

counter.name: Counter-split (反劈)
counter.text: Been split, and sure of your call? Counter, and the stakes double.

reshake.name: Reshake (散骰)
reshake.text: All five dice different? Show them to the table and shake again.

stop.name: Vote to stop
stop.text: Any time. When more than half the table votes, the game ends and the fewest cups win.

actions.note: The loser of a call starts the next round.

counts.lead: More players, more dice — and bigger calls. The table shows the least each call may be.
counts.note: Once someone is knocked out, the table counts only the players still in.

nightwatch.intro: The manor is haunted. Over five nights the watchers must light the seal lamp to lock the ghosts away — but some of them are possessed and quietly make the seal fail.

overview.win: The watchers win when three missions succeed — unless the assassin then names the Prophet. The ghosts win when three missions fail.
overview.secret: Your role is secret, and so is where you stand. Talk, work it out, and lie if you must.

teams.lead: Two hidden sides. Nobody knows who is who — except the ghosts, who know each other.

good.name: The watchers
good.text: {{roles}}. They win when three missions succeed and the assassin then misses the Prophet.

evil.name: The ghosts
evil.text: {{roles}}. They know each other. They win with three failed missions, five rejected teams in one night, or by naming the Prophet at the end.

roles.lead: Your role is dealt in secret. Which roles are in play depends on the number of players.
roles.prophet: Knows every ghost, except the Hermit. Guide the others quietly: if the watchers win, the assassin hunts you.
roles.apprentice: Sees two players: one is the Prophet, the other the Double. You can't tell which.
roles.tracker: Twice a game, on the patrol, follow a player instead of walking: you end up in the room they really reach, however far.
roles.keeper: Once a game, at the announcement, lock one door for the night. Everyone hears which door, never who locked it.
roles.watcher: No power. Patrol, listen and vote well.
roles.double: Twice a game, on the patrol, leave a decoy in another room you could reach. People there see you; in your real room nobody does.
roles.possessed: No power. Blend in and make the seal fail.
roles.assassin: The ghost in the lowest seat is also the assassin, who gets the last chance at the end.
roles.decoy: The Double's decoy counts as a person in its room (not for the Garden), the Kitchen hears the decoy's room, and in the Dining Room the decoy passes as good. The Apprentice sees the Double as a possible Prophet.

play.lead: Everyone starts in the Hall. Each of the {{nights}} nights goes like this:

announce.title: Announcement
announce.detail: Tonight's mission room and team size, and the next night's room. From night 2, a night event too.

patrol.title: Patrol, in secret
patrol.detail: Stay, or walk one room up, down, left or right. Then you see who shares your room. Nobody else knows where you are.

room.title: Use your room
room.detail: Each room does something (see Rooms). Not in tonight's mission room or the Hall, and not the same room two nights running.

talk.title: Talk
talk.detail: The Gallery's anonymous letters are read first. Then discuss. Lying is allowed.

team.title: Team and vote
team.detail: The leader (in seat order; the Bell Tower cuts in) names exactly the team size. Everyone votes in public: more than half must approve, or the next leader tries.

mission.title: Mission
mission.detail: The team walks to the mission room, two rooms at most. Each plays Success or Fail in secret; watchers can only play Success.

play.cards: One Fail breaks the seal (two on night 4 with 7+ players). Only the number of Fails is shown. If anyone on the team can't reach the room, the mission fails at once. The team stays there for the next patrol.
play.last: When three missions succeed, the ghosts are revealed and talk it over. Then the assassin names the Prophet: right, and the ghosts win; wrong, and the watchers win.
play.rejected: Five rejected teams in one night and the ghosts win.

rooms.lead: The house is 3 × 3 rooms. You walk up, down, left or right — never diagonally.
rooms.mission: Each night's mission room is drawn at random (never the Hall, never twice in a row). The next one is announced a night early.
rooms.use: After the patrol, use your room. A room that needs an exact number of people works with no other number.
rooms.tip: Plan your patrol a night ahead: the next mission room is already known, and the team can walk at most two rooms to it.

text.belltower: You lead this round: you cut in, then the order carries on.
text.study: Pick one of last night's team and learn whether they played Success or Fail.
text.chapel: Tonight's mission loses one Fail card. It works once a game, and isn't used up if there was no Fail. Only those in the Chapel learn if it worked; anyone who comes later can read in the book whether someone prayed each night (not who).
text.gallery: Write one sentence. It's shown, with no name, when the talk starts.
text.hall: No function, but it's one step from four rooms.
text.dining: The two of you each learn the other's side.
text.cellar: If you're on tonight's team, you reach the mission room from here at any distance. If not, next patrol you can go to any room.
text.kitchen: Pick a player and learn which room they ended up in after this patrol.
text.garden: Learn how many people are in each room tonight — but not who they are.

events.lead: From night 2, one event is turned at each announcement for everyone to see — so {{count}} of these {{total}} come up in a game.

text.blackout: After the patrol you can't see who shares your room — only whether anyone does.
text.collapse: A random room caves in: nobody can enter it again, and anyone inside moves to the Hall. Never tonight's or the next night's mission room.
text.secretDoor: Two random diagonal rooms are joined: you can walk straight between them.
text.storm: Nobody can move on the patrol, and the Tracker can't follow anyone.
text.insomnia: Everyone may walk up to two rooms on the patrol.
text.echo: The Gallery may post two anonymous letters.
text.fog: The team can walk only one room to the mission, not two.

counts.lead: {{min}} to {{max}} players. The table sets the sides, the roles dealt and each night's team:
counts.star: * That night's mission needs two Fail cards to fail.
counts.note: Five rejected teams in one night and the ghosts win, at any table size.

shelter.intro: Winter has come and the town is gone. You've barricaded yourselves into an old house and must last 6 days until the rescue convoy arrives. Everyone starts on the same side — but on the 2nd or 3rd night the sickness takes one of you. From then on they want the shelter to starve, and nobody knows who it is.

overview.lead: Winter. You're shut in an old house, scavenging by day and guarding the food by night, waiting {{days}} days for the rescue convoy.
overview.turn: Everyone starts as a Survivor — but on the 2nd or 3rd night one of you secretly turns Infected and starts starving the shelter.
overview.win: The Survivors win if enough of them are standing when the convoy comes, or if they send every Infected out. The Infected win if the shelter starves.
overview.length: {{min}}–{{max}} players. Every day you talk, scavenge and keep watch.

teams.lead: Two sides — but at the start everyone is on the same one.

survivors.name: Survivors
survivors.text: Everyone, until the cough. They win if enough Survivors are still standing after supper on night {{days}} (see Player counts), or as soon as every Infected has been sent out.

infected.name: The Infected
infected.text: They win if the storeroom runs out and enough people go hungry (a famine), if the Survivors standing are no more than the Infected, or if too few Survivors are left when the convoy comes.

roles.lead: Everyone starts as a Survivor. The Infected is chosen in secret partway through.

survivor.name: Survivor
survivor.text: By day, scavenge at a place and play a card into the haul. At night, guard the storeroom or the door, or sleep. Guard where the Infected strikes and you see who it is.

infected.name: Infected
infected.text: A random Survivor turns at nightfall, and only they know. By day you may play Sabotage, which turns over as ordinary Mould (−2). At night, steal from the storeroom or open the door (see Actions).

roles.second: With {{count}}+ players a second Survivor turns two nights after the first. The two Infected don't know each other.
roles.sneak: With {{count}} players the Infected can Sneak once: that night's strike works even past a guard, and nobody sees who it was.

play.lead: {{days}} days. Each day goes like this:

vote.title: Morning vote
vote.detail: From the day after the cough: talk about the night, then vote. More than half of those standing on one name sends them out, and their role is shown.

search.title: Pick a place
search.detail: In secret: the farm, the market, or the hospital ({{count}}+ players). Anyone injured stays home.

play.title: Play a card
play.detail: Draw 2 cards from your place (1 if tired or weak) and play 1 face down. Each place's cards are shuffled and shown; their total goes into the storeroom.

night.title: Night posts
night.detail: Everyone secretly picks the storeroom, the door or bed (see Actions).

supper.title: Supper
supper.detail: Everyone standing eats 1 food. If it runs short, someone goes hungry: weak tomorrow (1 card). Hungry two nights running and they fall.

play.cough: The cough: at nightfall on night 2 or 3 the app announces that someone has turned — never who.
play.out: The fallen and those sent out can only watch. Sending out a Survivor doesn't end the game: one fewer to scavenge, but one fewer mouth too.

actions.lead: At night everyone secretly picks one of three posts. The Infected sees the same three, but each means something else.

store.survivor: Guard it: catch anyone who comes to steal.
store.infected: Steal: if nobody guards it, take a third of the storeroom (at least 2).

door.survivor: Guard it: catch anyone who comes to open it.
door.infected: Open it: if nobody guards it, a zombie gets in. The storeroom loses 1 and a sleeper is hurt (stays home tomorrow).

sleep.infected: Pretend to sleep: do nothing, and nobody can see you.

actions.guard: One guard to a post: the first to choose it; anyone later goes back to bed. A strike that meets a guard fails, and the guard sees who it was.

places.title: Places
places.lead: By day everyone picks a place in secret. Each has its own deck, drawn at random.
places.farm: The steady place: mostly food, but some comes back empty or mouldy.
places.market: The most food, but plenty of it rots, and zombies roam.
places.hospital: Less food, but medicine: at dawn, each one treats an injured or weak player.
places.cards: Play a Zombie and you're bitten: you stay home tomorrow. Mould takes food away — and the Infected's Sabotage looks exactly like it.

counts.lead: {{min}} to {{max}} players. The table sets the Infected, the food and what each side needs:
counts.rescueNote: Rescue needs: Survivors still standing after supper on night {{days}}.
counts.famineNote: Famine at: if the storeroom is empty and this many go hungry, the Infected win.
counts.votesNote: Votes are counted with everyone standing; the number drops as people fall or are sent out (always more than half of those standing).

role.title: Your role
role.reveal: Tap to reveal — keep it secret

merlin.name: Handler
merlin.desc: You know who the moles are. Steer the agents without being exposed — if the Hitman names you, the moles win.

percival.name: Bodyguard
percival.desc: You know who the Handler is — but the Decoy looks the same to you. Protect the Handler.

servant.name: Field Agent
servant.desc: You know nothing. Find the moles and make three operations succeed.

assassin.name: Hitman
assassin.desc: Make three operations fail. If the agents complete three, you get one guess at the Handler.

morgana.name: Decoy
morgana.desc: You look like the Handler to the Bodyguard. Make three operations fail.

mordred.name: Sleeper
mordred.desc: The Handler cannot see you. Make three operations fail.

oberon.name: Wildcard
oberon.desc: You are a mole, but you and the other moles don't know each other.

minion.name: Mole
minion.desc: Make three operations fail without being caught.

quest.title: Operation {{quest}} is underway
quest.secret: Your card is secret. Agents can only play Success.
quest.hold: Hold a card for 2 seconds to play it.

assassinate.pick: Name the Handler to steal the win
